name: Danielle Rubio
reason: Her work is mainly trauma treatment: she presents herself as a Somatic Trauma Coach teaching women to overcome trauma, and her method came from her own recovery from PTSD, anxiety and insomnia. Every offering on danielle-rubio.com fails the health-claim rule: Rewire to Rise ('calm your anxiety for good'), the Pulse & Presence workshops ('release trauma', 'break free from anxiety'), the Rise To Renaissance retreat, and the free Foundation for Change trauma masterclass and EmbodiedMind class (anxiety, depression, insomnia). Her Shift course is also an April 2027 placeholder. Only a handful of general nervous-system videos on her YouTube channel (@daniellerubio, 355 subscribers) would pass, so the page would have nothing to offer but videos and a bio that has to leave out her central work. Email danielle@danielle-rubio.com is published on her homepage if a human wants to reconsider.
